tradeoffs.loses: Claude calls made through Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint are served and billed by Router instead of the configured Anthropic account, and only when the configured model id is a Router catalog id (the shipped claude-3-7-* ids are not, so they stay on Anthropic).
tradeoffs.why: config.example.toml, the config the app falls back to when no config.toml exists, points the OpenAI SDK at https://api.anthropic.com/v1/; without this unlock every Claude deployment of this app keeps all its traffic off Router.
